 There are enough K-pop concerts and world tours this year to make keeping track of who's touring where a challenge.

 Advertisement Advertisement As the genre becomes more popular in the States and across the globe, artists have begun expanding their horizons, taking their tours beyond Asia to stop in North America and beyond. That's not even including the K-pop acts headlining music festivals and conventions that are taking place this year.
 On the docket for 2026, we've seen big names embarking on massive world tours and even Las Vegas residencies, like BLACKPINK's Lisa's Viva La Lisa . Epik High, BOYNEXTDOOR and KATSEYE are just a few big names touring towards the end of the year, with more artists announcing tours all the time. To keep you in the know, we've compiled a list of K-pop concerts happening in 2026 so far and where you can buy tickets. As always, keep in mind that the official spot to grab tickets to all of these events will be via Ticketmaster . That being said, we've also included links to resale and third-party sites.
